name: legion-worker-omp-plugins
description: The Oh My Pi plugins the worker image links into its `legion` profile, installed from this directory's bun.lock with `bun install --frozen-lockfile` (worker.Dockerfile's plugin stage). @bopstack/pi-codegraph is pinned to the version the devbox runs (omp/plugins/package.json); its peer dependencies, which Bun installs beside it, are pinned by the lockfile alone.
